pages.title: Impala
pages.text: The impala ($(o)Aepyceros melampus$()) is a medium-sized antelope of the woodland edges and savannas of eastern and southern Africa.$(br2)It has a reddish back over paler flanks and a black "M" on its rump, and only the rams carry the long, ridged, lyre-shaped horns.$(br2)When startled, a herd scatters in huge bounding leaps that confuse the predator chasing it.
